name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.177: The two download-sync section intros had grown to 392 and 493 characters of
    measured detail - "accurate to about 0.2 s", "36 drifting episodes: worst line 10.74 s to
    0.17 s, 36 of 36 improved" - which is spec and commit material, not settings-page text. Both
    are cut to what the section does (222 and 256), and a structural check now holds every h4
    intro under 300 rendered characters and free of measured values, so the storytelling cannot
    creep back. The same pass drops a failure share from the audio-track switch.
